title: 00.01. Title Page
outcome: You can identify the edition, its scope and provenance, and the basic RAG terminology.

title: 00.02. Contents
outcome: You can locate each topic in the original book through its complete section and printed-page map.

title: 00.03. Preface
outcome: You can explain why RAG design requires reasoning about production decisions and their consequences.

title: 00.04. How to Use This Book
outcome: You can choose a reading route, follow its prerequisites, and use the recurring study sections.

title: 00.05. For Interview Candidates
outcome: You can prepare for design, derivation, and debugging questions with deliberate interview practice.

title: 00.06. For Practicing Engineers
outcome: You can connect the material to engineering decisions, failure modes, and operational costs.

title: 00.07. Notation and Symbols
outcome: You can interpret the symbols, abbreviations, and measurement conventions used across the book.

title: 00.08. Acknowledgments
outcome: You can identify the contributions and sources that shaped the book and its treatment of negative results.

title: 00.09. About the Author
outcome: You can identify Hao Hoang as the source author and locate the stated contact and correction channels.

title: Chapter 1. What a RAG Interview Actually Tests
outcome: You can choose where knowledge belongs, price that choice, and recognize when retrieval is the wrong tool.
group: Part I. The RAG Interview Landscape

outcome: You can compare RAG with continual learning, model editing, long context, and generative retrieval under stated constraints.

outcome: You can use circuits, induction heads, and attribution to reason about failures while respecting the limits of interpretability evidence.
